name: Ultracab (India) Limited
about: Ultracab (India) Limited manufactures and exports electric wires and cables in India. The company offers PVC/XLPE power and control cables for various transmission applications; multicore flexible cables for industries; house wires/building wires; flat cables for submersible pumps; aerial bunched cables; telephone cables; elevator cables, instrumentation cables; PVC cables; XLPE power cables; and braided cables, as well as auto, industrial, welding, and electric power cables. It also provides super flat submersible cables, ultra triple protected house wires, elevator cables, solar and control cables, and XLPE submersible cables; single core wires and multicore cables; and submersible winding wires. The company exports its products to the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, Africa, Singapore, and internationally. It serves government authorities, public sector undertakings and large private sector enterprises. Ultracab (India) Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Rajkot, India.
